decisions.reason: As a low-complexity but system-consistent care add-on, the cleaning soap is easy to retain and management can justify another year because it supports the full-service flooring offer.
The maintenance oil line is closely tied to the installed base of wood floors and, after another year on the market, accumulated commitment and model variety make withdrawal unlikely.

The high-density underlay foam remains more droppable than the core floor and care lines because it is a more substitutable accessory, but management is still likely to continue with it after already backing it through 2024.
The oak parquet line sits nearest the firm's core strategy and capabilities, so sunk launch effort, visible commitment, and strategic fit all strongly favor continuation.
